title: Puthoff later briefs Grusch's group

tellings.quote: somewhere in that period they finally got to be meet with Hal put off and and he briefed them with his set of information

plain: Eric Davis, a physicist, said on Jesse Michels's podcast that the group around David Grusch, a whistleblower who has gone public with claims about hidden UFO programs, eventually got to meet Hal Puthoff, a physicist long involved in this research. Davis says Puthoff then briefed them with his own set of information. He gives no date or place, but the story would mean that Puthoff's knowledge helped shape what Grusch's group came to believe.
